$comment: Feature comparison for outline Section IV. Product facts change often: each row records where it came from and when it was checked. 'autonomy' uses the scale defined below. Pricing is deliberately left out of the paper table because plans change monthly.

autonomyScale.L1: Suggestion: inline completion the developer accepts or rejects
autonomyScale.L2: Conversational: chat proposes edits; developer applies them
autonomyScale.L3: Supervised local agent: plans, edits files and runs commands in the developer's environment, with approvals
autonomyScale.L4: Asynchronous delegated agent: works in a remote sandbox and returns a branch, diff or pull request for review

assistants.name: GitHub Copilot
interactionModes: Cloud agent assigned from issues, chat or agent panel
assistants.context: Repository-scoped; GitHub MCP server gives issue and PR history; custom instructions at personal, repository and organisation level
assistants.tooling: MCP servers, custom agents, agent skills, hooks
assistants.execution: Cloud agent runs in a temporary cloud development environment, edits, runs tests and linters
assistants.deployment: IDE extensions plus GitHub.com; cloud agent works only on GitHub-hosted repositories
assistants.prOutput: Creates a branch and opens one PR per task; 59-minute session cap; rulesets can block it

assistants.name: Cursor
interactionModes: Cloud Agents launched from editor, web, mobile, Slack, GitHub or Linear
assistants.context: Indexed workspace in the editor; cloud agents get the repo, dependencies and configured secrets
assistants.tooling: Editor tools, terminal, MCP; per-environment secrets and network policies
assistants.execution: Cloud Agents run in a separate sandboxed VM per agent
assistants.deployment: Desktop editor (VS Code-derived) plus web and mobile control surfaces
assistants.prOutput: Cloud agents can open a PR with videos, screenshots and logs attached

assistants.name: Claude Code
interactionModes: Slack and CI (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD)
assistants.context: Reads the codebase on demand; CLAUDE.md (or AGENTS.md) project instructions; auto memory
assistants.tooling: MCP, skills, hooks, subagents, Agent SDK
assistants.execution: Runs commands locally under a permission system, or in cloud sessions
assistants.deployment: Local CLI/IDE/desktop, browser, scheduled cloud tasks, CI
assistants.prOutput: Stages, commits, creates branches and opens PRs; Slack mention can return a PR

assistants.name: OpenAI Codex
assistants.context: Checks out the repo at a branch/commit; AGENTS.md tells the agent lint and test commands
assistants.tooling: Terminal in a container; setup and maintenance scripts; MCP in the CLI
assistants.execution: Cloud container from the 'universal' image; internet off by default during the agent phase (setup scripts may use it)
assistants.deployment: Cloud plus local CLI and IDE
assistants.prOutput: Returns an answer and a diff; the user opens a PR from it
assistants.note: Not the 2021 Codex model that powered the first Copilot. The paper must keep the two apart.
